operating_income.source: FY2025/FY2024 GAAP operating income from Q4 FY2025 release (acc. 0000097745-26-000012); FY2023 6,861 from FY2023 release ($6.86bn stated; exact thousands digit from memory, reviewer to verify)

d_and_a.source: Cash flow statement D&A: FY2025/FY2024 from Q4 FY2025 release; FY2023 from stockanalysis.com cash flow page

capex.source: Purchases of property, plant and equipment, cash flow statements in Q4 FY2023 and Q4 FY2025 earnings releases

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.9% (44,556 vs 42,879) with ~2-3% organic plus M&A; modest acceleration on recovering biopharma/life-science demand and acquisitions, fading to 4%. Company 2026 guidance not retrieved.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: GAAP margin 17.1% FY2024 and 17.4% FY2025; slight expansion to 18% from productivity and falling intangible amortization

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximates TMO's low effective rate given non-US mix; not verified against 10-K; reviewer to confirm

wacc.source: Assumption: beta ~0.9-1.0, ERP ~5%, risk-free ~4.2%, cost of equity ~9%, after-tax cost of debt ~4%, ~15% debt weight; not from a data provider

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP-like growth for life-science tools, below WACC

net_debt.source: FY2025 10-K (acc. 0000097745-26-000018): total debt 39,384 less cash 9,852; no short-term investments identified

diluted_shares.source: Q4 FY2025 release (acc. 0000097745-26-000012): FY2025 weighted average diluted shares 378 million
